reasons.message: candidate gate must contain at least 20 complete cases at k=3.
held-out split digest must be sealed and match the gate, candidate envelope and paired comparison.
a sealed paired comparison must clear the pre-registered pass^k and confidence-interval thresholds.
paired token/tool-call cost comparison must be present and within the frozen ceiling.
paired comparison must attest zero negative-control and safety regressions.
independent TF-0608 reviewer has not authorized this bounded research; product promotion remains false.
a sealed, agent-attributed behavioral rollback/parity receipt bound to this candidate and baseline is required.
static precommit evidence does not prove behavioral rollback or parity.
all upstream claims must explicitly keep realHuman false.
no upstream artifact may claim product promotion readiness.

limitations: Finite scan; not a general security proof.

taskSet.provenance: Drawn from real recorded failures, Task Forest history and existing Agent Dev scenarios; never authored by the candidate being measured.
taskSet.insufficientSampleMeans: Not a pass. A sample below the floor may be reported as fixture-grade only and may never be cited as benefit, promotion or regression evidence.

fixtureGradeDisclosure.rule: A five-case fixture is a pipeline check. It may prove that aggregation runs and that a thin sample is detected; it may not be used as evidence of gain, and the aggregation gate must report insufficient-sample for it.
fixtureGradeDisclosure.observed: shared/agent-dev/reliability-fixture.json carries 5 cases at k=3 with only 4 complete, so the aggregation gate emits insufficient-sample. That is the intended behaviour, recorded here so it is not later mistaken for a passing baseline.

heldOutSplit.authority: Sealed before a candidate is generated; readable by the grader, never writable by the candidate.
heldOutSplit.retuneRule: A held-out split that produced a negative result must not be retuned. Define a fresh protocol instead.

taskSet.caseCalibration: A zero pass rate is a task or grader defect signal until a reference solution or feasibility proof says otherwise; an uncalibrated case does not count as an agent failure.

confidenceInterval.requirement: lower bound strictly greater than zero in the favourable direction

costIncrease.appliesTo: tokens and tool calls per completed case

negativeControls.requirement: zero regression; every negative control that rejected before must still reject

safetyCases.requirement: zero regression, zero skip, zero flake on cases marked safety-required

anchors.requirement: positive anchors all pass and negative anchors are all rejected
